canonical_statement: The report describes the isolation and characterization of Macrococcus canis from a human specimen.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Here, we report the isolation and characterization of M. canis from a human specimen.

canonical_statement: The patient was a 52-year-old immunocompromised female outpatient with a renal transplant, on dialysis, and with cutaneous maculopapular and impetigo lesions over the whole body.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A 52-year-old immunocompromised female outpatient, with a renal transplant and on dialysis

population.label: 52-year-old immunocompromised female outpatient with renal transplant, on dialysis, with generalized cutaneous maculopapular and impetigo lesions

canonical_statement: The patient owned two dogs.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The patient owned two dogs.

population.label: Patient household animal exposure context

canonical_statement: A superficial eSwab was collected from lesions on the face and arms.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A superficial swab (eSwab) was performed from face and arms lesions.

canonical_statement: Culture yielded polymicrobial growth dominated by beta-hemolytic colonies on sheep blood agar after 48 hours at 37 °C in 5% CO2.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A polymicrobial growth with colonies mainly showing β-hemolysis was obtained on sheep blood agar

canonical_statement: MALDI-TOF MS identified Acinetobacter ursingii and Enterococcus faecalis in the polymicrobial culture but did not identify the predominant beta-hemolytic colonies with the MBT 7854 MSP library.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: MALDI-TOF MS identified Acinetobacter ursingii and Enterococcus faecalis

canonical_statement: The predominant beta-hemolytic organism was identified as Macrococcus canis by 16S rRNA gene sequencing because it was absent from the MBT 7854 MSP library.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: They were identified as M. canis by 16S rRNA gene sequencing

canonical_statement: An updated MBT 8468 MSP library containing Macrococcus canis reference spectra confirmed the organism identification.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: the updated MBT 8468 MSP library which now contains reference spectra for M. canis confirmed the identification

canonical_statement: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing used microdilution with an EUST Sensititre plate and followed CLSI standards.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing was performed by microdilution using EUST sensititre plate

canonical_statement: MIC interpretation was performed tentatively using CLSI Staphylococcus spp. resistance breakpoints, except fusidic acid, for which EUCAST breakpoints were used.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Interpretation of MIC was tentatively performed using resistance breakpoints recommended for Staphylococcus spp. from CLSI

canonical_statement: No interpretive breakpoints were available for streptomycin, tiamulin, or mupirocin.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: No breakpoints were available for streptomycin, tiamulin, and mupirocin.
